programs.title: UEFA Champions League Classics
programs.subtitle: 2001/02: Feyenoord v Newcastle United
programs.description: We revisit the 2001/02 UEFA Champions League group stage tie between Feyenoord and Newcastle in Rotterdam. The Toon had to win to secure a place in the competition's second phase.

programs.title: UEFA Champions League Classics
programs.subtitle: 2003/04 Quarter-Final, 2nd Leg: Deportivo La Coruna v AC Milan
programs.description: We revisit the second leg of the 2003/04 UEFA Champions League quarter-final between Deportivo La Coruña and AC Milan at the Riazor Stadium. Milan led 4-0 from the first leg.

programs.title: UEFA Champions League Classics
programs.subtitle: 2004/05: Manchester United v Fenerbahce
programs.description: We revisit the 2004/05 UEFA Champions League group stage tie between Manchester United and Fenerbahçe at Old Trafford. The match saw Wayne Rooney make his highly anticipated debut.

programs.title: UEFA Champions League Classics
programs.subtitle: 2008/09 Semi-Final: Arsenal v Manchester United
programs.description: We revisit the semi-final second leg from the 2008/09 UEFA Champions League between Arsenal and Manchester United. John O'Shea's goal had given United a 1-0 first leg advantage.
